_comment: Definition of every ablation arm: what it is, the parameters that make it that, the ONE variable it isolates, and the arm it should be read against. run-eval.sh embeds the matching entry into each run's manifest so an archive explains itself without reference to a runner script or a chat log.

A.description: Inline ownership rules, catalog tool offered. The 35B declines it 250/250; the 4B calls it 249/249, so this arm measures different things per rig.

A0.description: Arm A with the catalog skill removed. A minus A0 is what the catalog contributes when the model actually reads it (4B) or nothing (35B). allow_diff: replays <rig>-A's own archived notes, so match inputs are identical to A's by construction; the cache-sha diff is bookkeeping, verified 2026-07-28.

B.description: Bare label set, no rules, no catalog. The baseline every other arm is measured against.

C.variable: catalog content, delivered in the system prompt
C.description: Whole catalog pasted into the system prompt. Establishes what the catalog's content is worth before delivery is varied.

C2.variable: catalog FORMAT (prose vs term index), delivery held
C2.description: Term index pasted instead of prose catalog. Isolates format from delivery: both arrive in the system prompt.

P1.catalog: pasted into USER turn, before the issue
P1.variable: message ROLE (system vs user), order held
P1.description: Same bytes as C, moved from the system prompt into the user turn, still ahead of the issue. Requires curings-nopage: the 7215 B payload paginates under the 6000 default. allow_diff: pcache strips back to the base <rig>-A cache byte-for-byte on all 250 notes (verified 2026-07-28, both rigs); the spliced block IS the declared variable.

P2.catalog: pasted into USER turn, after the issue
P2.variable: ORDER (before vs after the issue), role held
P2.description: As P1 but the catalog follows the issue, so the model reads the question before the reference material. allow_diff: pcache strips back to the base <rig>-A cache byte-for-byte on all 250 notes (verified 2026-07-28, both rigs); the spliced block IS the declared variable.

D.variable: tool round + second forward pass, order held
D.description: Whole catalog returned as a tool result. Forcing is injected by the logprob proxy, since leather hardcodes tool_choice: auto — so this arm partly measures harness scaffolding. allow_diff: pcache strips back to the base <rig>-A cache byte-for-byte on all 250 notes (verified 2026-07-28, both rigs); the spliced block IS the declared variable.

Dn.description: Identical to D but the prompt never mentions fetching. Isolates how much of D's result comes from telling the model to fetch versus the fetch happening.

E.variable: retrieval payload: narrowed labels vs whole catalog
E.description: lookup_sig returns matching term rows only. Narrows to ~3.6 of 22 SIGs but returns labels, not descriptions.

E2.description: As E against the seeded index (64 hand-authored boundaries). Boundaries are ADVISORY here — surfaced for the model to weigh.

Eauto.description: As E with no forcing. The 35B calls it 1/250, the 4B 249/249 — the sharpest behavioural split between the rigs.

G.description: lookup_sig_v2 narrows by index then returns the candidates' FULL catalog entries, falling back to the whole catalog on a miss.

G2.variable: boundaries enforced in code vs offered as advice
G2.description: lookup_sig_v3 removes excluded SIGs before the model sees them. Motivated by measurement: under G the model was handed an exclusion on 57% of issues and cited one on 2%.

H.variable: does the catalog ADD to the rules
H.description: Arm A's exact prompt with the fetch forced. Tests whether catalog and rules are complementary or redundant. allow_diff: replays <rig>-A's own archived notes, so match inputs are identical to A's by construction; the cache-sha diff is bookkeeping, verified 2026-07-28.

T2.description: Turn 0 scoped to the catalog tool, turn 1 with tools: [] so the only legal move is the answer. Uses leather's own construct instead of injected tool_choice.

T3.description: Survey the concern with no tools, retrieve against the discriminators it named, then decide with tools withheld.

F.description: One stage: raw issue in, answer out, no analyze step. The only cell that removes a stage. Handicapped by pasted delivery — see F2.

F2.variable: the stage split, rules AND catalog handling held constant
F2.description: One stage with rules kept and the enforced v3 lookup. Original registered comparator was G2, which differs in BOTH stage count and rules — that comparison bundles the stage split with the established rules effect and is not a stage experiment. H2 (two stages, rules, enforced lookup) is the matched comparator; re-registered 2026-07-28. allow_diff: F2 removes the analyze stage by design, so no cache; verified note-equivalence does not apply — the missing stage IS the variable.

S1.catalog: candidate entries fetched by the decide stage
S1.variable: bounded context via a STAGE boundary
S1.description: Two curings: shortlist narrows to a concern plus 2-3 candidates with no catalog, then a FRESH SESSION decides from the shortlist alone, fetching only those candidates' entries. The decide stage never sees the analyze note or the whole catalog. Contrast with T3, where context grew 1206 -> 2828 tokens across turns because Session.Reset is unwired.

H2.description: Arm H with the catalog delivered by the enforced v3 lookup instead of a bulk fetch. Every other catalog arm removes the rules first; H delivers bulk alongside them. Since the 4B gains most from narrowing (+5.2 vs 35B +2.0) and least from bulk (+4.0 vs +7.6), rules+narrowed is its untested best case. allow_diff: replays <rig>-A's own archived notes, so match inputs are identical to A's by construction; the cache-sha diff is bookkeeping, verified 2026-07-28.

T2c.catalog: fetched via per-turn tool scope; decide turn CLEARED
T2c.variable: per-turn context clearing (bounded decide, no queue hop)
T2c.description: Arm T2 with `clear: true` on the decide turn: the conversation is reset before the decide prompt, so the raw catalog blob and the note are dropped and the decide turn sees only the system prompt plus the shortlist the model recorded via record_shortlist (carried across the boundary by a skill extract into {{shortlist}}). Varies clearing AND the recording tool call vs T2 — the recording is the mechanism's cost of carriage, not a separate treatment. Read against T2 (cost of dropping raw context) and against S1's decide stage at 85.4% given gold survived (bounded decide without S1's lossy funnel).

T2cr.catalog: fetched via per-turn tool scope; shortlist recorded, context KEPT
T2cr.variable: the record/extract carrier alone (clearing held OFF)
T2cr.description: T2c's full carrier machinery — record_shortlist call, extract into {{shortlist}}, re-injection in the decide prompt — with clear: true removed, so the decide turn keeps the raw context AND receives the carried shortlist. T2cr vs T2 prices the carrier overhead; T2c vs T2cr isolates the clearing itself (modulo one preamble sentence that would otherwise state a falsehood). Designed 2026-07-28 as the review-requested control for the bundled T2c result.
